summary: A repaired, fail-closed proposal for a narrow offline continuation-writer/interface floor. It replaces dream-growth and organism-consolidation wording with closed-world provenance extraction and assay-local supervised transport; it adds ordered A2 receipts, feasibility, full policy scanning, scoring identity, nonzero-adapter canaries, positive-action endpoints, one-shot salt provenance, real-seal access attestation, and claim-state precedence.
system_thesis: The complete organism thesis distinguishes lived action/outcome episodes; dream-time local connection growth and memory re-expression; parametric consolidation/transport; goal-conditioned retrieval, composition, planning, and revision; and later feedback from thought and outcomes into future dream cycles. This proposal exercises none of the complete recurrent route: it freezes historical lived episodes, performs closed-world provenance extraction, trains a quarantined assay-local adapter, evaluates a retrieval-empty one-decision writer, and terminates at reporting. Any behavior belongs only to this isolated package, never to a LoRA as discoverer or to the complete organism.
